 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Cleveland Browns are looking to bounce back after a tough road loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers. The Browns' game against the New Orleans Saints will look entirely different from the previous week, with Shedeur Sanders taking snaps under center . The offense will need to adjust to this change in preparation for the matchup. Beyond Sanders, there are several other key matchups that could help decide the outcome of this game.
 Chris Olave has 636 yards and two touchdowns this season, making him an important matchup for Denzel Ward . Ward has continued to prove why he is one of the best cornerbacks in the league this season, and he will face another test as he looks to limit Olave's production. Jordyn Tyson's return could add even more issues for the Browns defense.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Cleveland's offensive line struggled to protect Deshaun Watson last week. The offensive line will need to do a much better job of protecting Sanders if they want to give him a chance to run the offense effectively.
 The Browns struggled to stop the run against the Steelers and will want to improve on that part of their game against the Saints. New Orleans has struggled to stop the run this season, giving Cleveland a great opportunity to establish its dominance in that area.
